انطفأت (form VII)
# اِنْطَفَأْتُ (inṭafaʔtu) /in.tˤa.faʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# اِنْطَفَأْتَ (inṭafaʔta) /in.tˤa.faʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# اِنْطَفَأْتِ (inṭafaʔti) /in.tˤa.faʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# اِنْطَفَأَتْ (inṭafaʔat) /in.tˤa.fa.ʔat/: third-pe
